name: trackiq-amazon-catalog-hygiene
title: TrackIQ: Amazon Catalog and Variation Hygiene Audit
summary: Sweeps a whole Amazon catalogue for the quiet defects nobody owns — thin image sets, truncating or short titles, bullet counts above or below what displays, orphaned and duplicate SKUs, dead and GUID listings cluttering the inventory, products with no ads and no traffic, and listings that are live but not buyable — ranked by revenue at risk so the list is finite.

requires.third_party_note: Requires an Oxylabs scraper connection; the public page is the only source for this data.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. Outward sends confirm first.
